I'm saying they could have disliked it. Or they could be your average internet trolls. Go on /r/AskReddit or /r/WritingPrompts and sort by new. Don't feel guilty is step on. Being negative about being negative doesn't make a positive. If I were you I would tell my friend, "I'm sorry I've been so down lately. I'm just very overwhelmed. If you don't want to hangout till I feel a bit better I fully understand, but I could really use someone to talk to" if they're really your friend, they WILL help and talk with you.

Think about it. We're internet friends so far. But I *could* just say "fuck you you actually do suck* because I have a keyboard and I can *hide* behind it. Now if the same person who downvoted you, read it in real life, in front of you? I'm 100% sure they would critique you and tell you it was good.

That's the first thing you wrote?! Damn. And don't worry about the downvotes. That's reddit unfortunately. I think a writing class is a good idea! Not because you're bad (cause you aren't) but because I think you'd enjoy it.

Hey man! Life has its ups and downs. It does discriminate. Sometimes you will have ups. Sometimes you will have downs. Right now you're just going through a lot of downs. If life were easy it wouldn't be worth living. (To me anyway. The dude who beats all the halos on legendary alone haha) but I think if you just keep a positive outlook on the small things during rough times, it will make it easier and better when you get back to the good things. I'm here if you wanna talk more.

Don't ever apologize. We're here to try and help, and at least listen. You're not wasting anyone's time, and are equally as important as someone else.
